rundown: FCSB beat Chindia 2-1 at Stadionul Eugen Popescu in Targoviste. It was level at 0-0 at half-time.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 15, 4:56 AM ET. It had FCSB 27%, the draw 28% and Chindia 46%, projecting FCSB 1.1 – Chindia 1.5 (2.6 total, Chindia by 0.4).

Final: FCSB 2 – Chindia 1. Wrong winner: it had Chindia at 46%, and FCSB (27%) won.

Thin data: 3 of 6 key inputs were sourced (missing: CHI goals scored, CHI goals allowed, CHI lineup rating or past seasons), so league averages filled the gaps. It was logged as a no-data call: graded and learned from, never offered as a bet.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
FCSB came in with a 6% below average attack and a 10% leakier than average defense (no current-season scoring; 13 past seasons on file), worth about 15 and 15 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.1, they scored 2 (+0.9 goals, 86% over); projected to allow 1.5, they allowed 1 (−0.5 goals, 32% under).

Chindia came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 11 and 11 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.5, they scored 1 (−0.5 goals, 32% under); projected to allow 1.1, they allowed 2 (+0.9 goals, 86% over).

The bigger miss was FCSB's scoring (+0.9 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 3 against 2.6 projected (+0.4), about the 60th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±1.7).

Margin: FCSB by 1 against Chindia by 0.4 projected, about the 20th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.7).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: inputs were missing (CHI goals scored, CHI goals allowed, CHI lineup rating or past seasons); there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.088 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -1.5 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 1082 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.1 goals. Team corrections so far: Chindia attack ×0.960, defense ×1.035 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
